about: Step 16 eval set for backend/samples/. expect = acceptable locations (file name + location label as stored). has (optional) = phrases, one of which the retrieved passage must contain, for locations whose other chunks hold unrelated text (a PDF page, a long section); matching ignores case and whitespace. A hit is a passage from an expected location that passes `has`. Two-document questions list parts instead, each answered by a different file; 'both' means every part has a hit in the top k. Drafted by Claude from the parsed sample text; locations and phrases to be checked by the owner.
